products.name: Nike Air Force 1 '07
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: Comfortable, durable and timeless—it's number one for a reason. The classic '80s construction pairs smooth leather with bold details for style that tracks whether you're on court or on the go.

products.name: Nike Dunk Low Retro
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: You can always count on a classic. This Dunk Low features a synthetic leather and textile upper with zigzag stitching for a retro look. Like all Dunks, it has plush padding for game-changing comfort that lasts.

products.name: Nike Marina
products.subtitle: Men's Slides
products.description: The Nike Marina offers soft comfort and effortless style. The leather strap is smooth and sturdy, while the foam underfoot makes every step comfortable.

products.name: Nike Waffle Racer
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: Eras collide when you lace up in the Nike Waffle Racer. It pairs old-school running details like a moccasin-inspired upper and an iconic Waffle sole with modern details like fresh colours and a comfortable foam midsole.

products.name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Premium
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: Bigger. Bouncier. Air. Staying true to the original human anatomy-inspired design, rippling layers of synthetic leather and airy mesh stack for a gradient look. The larger Max Air units in the heel and forefoot highlight the supremely cushioned design while elevating your style. Put a little more Air down there and enjoy your Air Max journey.

products.name: Nike Offcourt
products.subtitle: Women's Slides
products.description: Featuring Revive Foam, a super-soft foam designed to help you relax and recharge, the unrelenting comfort of the Nike Offcourt Slide is sensational. The innovative dual-layered foam and soft jersey lining on the strap ensure a gratifying full-foot experience. The iconic Air Force 1 pivot circle outsole and block lettering on the strap casually nod to heritage hoops.

products.name: Nike Sprint Sister
products.subtitle: Women's Shoes
products.description: The Sprint Sister returns – reimagined for the street. Inspired by Nike's 1979 women's-only track spike, it delivers comfort and flexibility in a polished package.

products.name: Nike Air Max Phenomena
products.subtitle: Women's Shoes
products.description: The Air Max Phenomena reimagines the Air Max SNDR as a sleek loafer. Premium materials combined with Max Air cushioning makes it comfortable enough to wear all day and stylish enough to wear all night.

products.name: Nike P-6000
products.subtitle: Women's Shoes
products.description: The P-6000 is a mash-up of Pegasus sneakers past. It takes the early 2000s running style to modern heights by combining sporty design lines with breathable textiles. And its foam cushioning adds a lifted, athletics-inspired stance for unbelievable comfort.

products.name: Nike Victori One
products.subtitle: Slides
products.description: From the beach to the stands, the Victori One is a must-have slide for everyday activities. Subtle yet substantial updates like a wider strap and softer foam make lounging easy. Go ahead—enjoy endless comfort for your feet.

products.name: Nike V5 RNR
products.subtitle: Boys' Shoes
products.description: Y2K vibes meet modern-day comfort in the V5 RNR. A throwback midsole is beefy yet lightweight. Mesh and metallic details on the upper keep your look sleek and your footwork breezy.

products.name: Nike Calm 2.0
products.subtitle: Girls' Slides
products.description: Keep Calm and slide on. Our second version is made with softer foam while keeping all the support you need. The minimal design makes these slides easy to style with or without socks. And they've got an updated, textured footbed to help keep your feet in place and feeling their best.

products.name: Nike Revolution 8
products.subtitle: Men's Road Running Shoes
products.description: The Revolution 8 is an evolution of your faithful favourite. Every stride is cushioned thanks to a foam midsole and a flexible forefoot that makes your steps soft. Plus, the mesh upper is even more breathable than the previous iteration, so you can run in cool, collected comfort.

products.name: Nike Alphafly 4
products.subtitle: Men's Road Racing Shoes
products.description: Our iconic racing shoe is back and lighter than ever. We've updated the Air Zoom unit for the first time in the Alphafly's history, making it softer and quieter. Advancements to our ZoomX foam deliver more bounce with less weight, opening up your marathon potential.

products.name: Nike Vomero 18
products.subtitle: Women's Road Running Shoes
products.description: Maximum cushioning in the Vomero provides a comfortable ride for everyday runs. Our softest, most cushioned ride has lightweight ZoomX foam stacked on top of responsive ReactX foam in the midsole. Plus, a redesigned traction pattern offers a smooth heel-to-toe transition.

products.name: Nike Pegasus 42
products.subtitle: Women's Road Running Shoes
products.description: Responsive cushioning in the Pegasus 42 provides an energised ride for everyday road runs. Experience power in every stride thanks to the propulsive feel of a curved, full-length Air Zoom unit and a ReactX foam midsole. An updated fit gives you more space in the forefoot and toe box.

products.name: Nike Zoom Fly 6
products.subtitle: Women's Road Racing Shoes
products.description: The Zoom Fly 6 is with you every step of your run. Lighter than the Zoom Fly 5, its responsive ZoomX foam adds energy return to each stride, while a carbon-fibre Flyplate helps propel you to the finishing line.

products.name: Nike Vaporfly 4
products.subtitle: Women's Road Racing Shoes
products.description: The Vaporfly 4 is a lean, mean, mile-eating machine. We trimmed weight in the midsole, outsole and upper from the Vaporfly 3, without sacrificing performance. The result is a lighter, more propulsive all-round racing shoe that's trusted from the mile to the marathon.

products.name: Nike Precision 8 Low
products.subtitle: Men's Basketball Shoes
products.description: Score at will at the rim or from deep in the Nike Precision 8 Low. Crafted with a combination of ground control, comfort and on-court traction, this low-top design is perfect for instant impact plays when your name is called. Check in and make the plays that swing the outcome in your favour.

products.name: Ja 4 'Blur' EP
products.subtitle: Basketball Shoes
products.description: Ja’s elevation is pure hang-time horror, and the Ja 4 packs the bounce that creates unguardable nightmares. Responsive Cushlon 3.0 foam delivers explosive lift and cushions every landing. Its sleek containment system pairs with a supportive upper to help you stay locked in and ready to terrorise any defender in your wake.

products.name: A'Two "Dawn Staley" EP
products.subtitle: Basketball Shoes
products.description: A'ja runs the floor at full speed, all game. That's why we made the A'Two more responsive than her original. If you're ready to keep pace with the M'VP, go full force with soft cushioning that combines with powerful Air Zoom in an encore with extra oomph. With its extra-durable rubber outsole, this version gives you traction for outdoor courts.

products.name: Nike S.T. Dynamite 'Werewolf'
products.subtitle: Boys' Basketball Shoes
products.description: Burst onto the court in style with the S.T. Dynamite, so you can hoop, howl and hunt in style. Designed for effortless mobility on both hardwood and asphalt, these kicks are perfect for any style of play. A grippy sole ensures accuracy at high speeds, while a breathable mesh upper keeps your kiddo light on their toes. It's the ultimate game shoe for the ultimate player: your little hooper. Show your fangs and let your foes know you're team werewolf all the way!

products.name: Caitlin 1 'Midnight Fever'
products.subtitle: Girls' Basketball Shoes
products.description: If Caitlin can make it from anywhere, so can you. The Caitlin 1 is made for those brave enough to chase down their dreams—and launch from deep. Cushlon foam helps you stay smooth and controlled through every move. The innovative Opticast upper delivers lightweight, locked-in support, so you can fearlessly hit the turbo button. Finished with signature details special to Caitlin, this shoe is made for hoopers who dare to shoot from any distance.

products.name: Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Magic Ball'
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: Inspired by the original that debuted in 1985, the Air Jordan 1 Low offers a clean, classic look that's familiar yet always fresh. With an iconic design that features details celebrating 30 years of Space Jam, these kicks ensure you'll always be on point.

products.name: Jordan Spizike Low 'Jam Central'
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: The Spizike takes elements of five classic Jordans, combines them and gives you one iconic sneaker. It's an homage to Spike Lee formally introducing Hollywood and hoops in a culture moment—and this pair celebrates 30 years of Space Jam with special details, like the Hare Jumpman on the tongue. You get a great-looking pair of kicks with some history. What more can you ask for? Ya dig?

products.name: Air Jordan 1 Low SE 'Lola Bunny'
products.subtitle: Women's Shoes
products.description: The Tune Squad is back with a fresh take on '90s nostalgia the whole family can rep, celebrating 30 years of Space Jam with Lola Bunny's signature style. Inspired by the original that debuted in 1985, the Air Jordan 1 Low offers a clean, classic look that's familiar yet always fresh—as well as some special touches for this pair, like the Hare Jumpman on the tongue. With an iconic design that pairs perfectly with any 'fit, these kicks ensure you'll always be on point.

products.name: Air Jordan Mule
products.subtitle: Women's Shoes
products.description: The Air Jordan Mule combines a classic loafer upper, a soft foam platform and heritage Jordan style. What you get is a sleek and comfortable shoe that's solid enough for everyday wear. Rubber sidewalls give you a chunky look while premium hardware adds an elegant touch.

products.name: Jordan Franchise
products.subtitle: Slides
products.description: Made from robust yet flexible foam, these slides support your every step. A slight curve in the footbed helps keep the fit feeling secure. And with the Jumpman front and centre, you can show off your Jordan pride.

products.name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 17 Elite
products.subtitle: Men's Firm-Ground Low-Top Football Boots
products.description: The Vapor 17 Elite is unbelievably light. Made with Nike's lightest tech ever, it unleashes blinding quickness with its FlyLite plate and feathery Atomknit upper. That agile pairing sets you up to win in tight spaces, while its bladed traction pattern powers every sharp pivot and cut.

products.name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Academy
products.subtitle: Men's Multi-Ground Low-Top Football Boots
products.description: Level up your accuracy with the Phantom 6 Academy. It powers your precision with a NikeSkin touch zone, located where you need it for clean strikes. The grippy texture helps you take advantage of scoring opportunities by bringing your foot closer to the ball.

products.name: Nike Air Max Plus Premium
products.subtitle: Men's Shoes
products.description: Let your attitude have the edge in the Air Max Plus. Its iconic caging adds heat to your look while airy mesh keeps you cool. And the visible cushioning lets you celebrate your defiant style in comfort.
